Thanks for the context, Ethan / Anna. Quick checklist from Redwood tax acceptance:  

Required items to clear PO (pick one pathway):
1) Wet-signed W-9 (PDF) + photo ID (driver's license or passport) of the signer; our team redacts ID after verification.
2) e-Signed W-9 with email-based audit trail (DocuSign or equivalent) showing signer and timestamp.
3) IVR OTP phone verification — must include: phone number used, date/time, audio file OR verbatim transcript, and a short note from the signer confirming they are authorized to sign tax forms for the entity.

For delegated-signature situations: we require a short Delegated Signer Affidavit (one-page PDF) naming the signer and the authority basis (board resolution, POA, or title-based authority). If the signer is CEO/CFO, affidavit is optional but helpful.

To expedite, please:
- Attach the signed W-9 (pathway 1) OR DocuSign audit (pathway 2) OR IVR transcript + signed confirmation (pathway 3).
- If delegated signer, attach the one-page affidavit.

I am attaching a short procurement_w9_instructions.pdf with templates for the affidavit and required fields. Once Marcus confirms EIN match on our end, we will issue the PO. If you send the artifacts today we'll target PO issuance on 2026-09-21.

Kimberly Park
